name: Keep Her Alive
source:
Sam is exhausted from cleaning up after her reckless writer, Bella, whose habit of going rogue constantly delays book releases—and costs Sam’s company dearly.

When Bella insists on spending a few weeks in a mysterious, supposedly haunted house to research her next novel, Sam is forced to confront a childhood trauma she thought she had buried. Determined to keep Bella safe—and herself from past fears—Sam reluctantly accompanies her.

What begins as a tense professional obligation quickly spirals into a chilling nightmare… and a delicate, forbidden tension that neither of them can ignore. 

[From [url=https://thatnewdevgirl.itch.io/keep-her-alive]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山姆因清理她鲁莽的作家贝拉而精疲力尽，贝拉的无赖习惯不断推迟书籍的发行，并让山姆的公司付出了高昂的代价。

当贝拉坚持要在一个神秘的、据说是鬼屋的房子里呆上几个星期来研究她的下一部小说时，山姆被迫面对她认为自己已经埋葬的童年创伤。山姆决心保护贝拉的安全，并让她自己免受过去的恐惧影响，山姆不情愿地陪伴着她。

一开始是紧张的职业义务，很快就演变成一场令人毛骨悚然的噩梦……以及一种他们都无法忽视的微妙的、禁忌的紧张气氛。

[来自[url=https://thatnewdevgirl.itch.io/keep-her-alive]itch.io[/url]]
